game_title: Infinite Loop Trap – Lantern Crossing Rush
game_concept: A arcade set in Shadow Cave – Lantern Crossing, a rope bridge over a pit: the spelunker must handle zombies while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Infinite Loop Trap: Find the missing update line that makes a loop never stop, before zombies overload Lantern Crossing.
theme: Shadow Cave – Lantern Crossing: a rope bridge over a pit
core_gameplay_loop: In Lantern Crossing, repeat each round: Find the missing update line that makes a loop never stop, before zombies overload Lantern Crossing. Each round, a new rope coils challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the loop_safety value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 240 points of rope coils by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 240, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 7 (applied tier): Infinite Loop Trap
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how loop_safety changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against zombies in Lantern Crossing.
